tools.name: contact
tools.description: This is for Norcal to contact the client in case they have additional questions

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search this knowledge base for content relevant to a natural-language query. Returns the closest-matching snippets with their source, not an exhaustive list.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List this business's products from its extracted catalogue. This is a complete, enumerable list with a total count — unlike `products`, which is a semantic search returning only the closest matches. Use `filter` to narrow by name and `offset` to page.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Look up one product by name, as returned by list_products, with a short excerpt of the page describing it and any documents the business has attached to it — an installation guide, a spec sheet. Those attachments are the authoritative answer to "where are the instructions for X": when the list is em

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List this business's services from its extracted catalogue. This is a complete, enumerable list with a total count — unlike `services`, which is a semantic search returning only the closest matches. Use `filter` to narrow by name and `offset` to page.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Look up one service by name, as returned by list_services, with a short excerpt of the page describing it. If no such service exists this says so plainly and suggests the nearest names — treat that as authoritative: the business does not offer it.

tools.name: services
tools.description: Find service offerings relevant to a natural-language query. Returns the closest matches, not a complete list — use `list_services` for the complete catalogue.

tools.name: products
tools.description: Find products relevant to a natural-language query. Returns the closest matches, not a complete catalogue — use `list_products` for the complete catalogue.

tools.name: troubleshoot
tools.description: Find the resolution for a problem a customer is reporting, or the answer to a question they asked, from question-and-answer pairs extracted out of this business's FAQ pages and installation guides. Use this the moment a customer reports that something is wrong or does not work — it returns the actua

tools.name: faq
tools.description: Answer a question from this knowledge base's FAQ content. Returns the closest-matching FAQ passages, not extracted answers — for a customer reporting that something is broken, `troubleshoot` returns the resolution itself.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
